verses.geez: ኢታቅንኣ፡ ለብእሲተ፡ ሕፅንከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትትመሀር፡ ላዕሌከ፡ ትምህርተ፡ እኩየ።
verses.translation: Be not jealous over the wife of thy bosom, and teach her not an evil lesson against thyself.

translations.lxx: Be not jealous over the wife of thy bosom, and teach her not an evil lesson against thyself.
translations.ron: Nu fi gelos de soţia ta iubită şi nu-i da cuvânt să-ţi facă rău.
translations.grk: Μὴ ζήλου γυναῖκα τοῦ κόλπου σου, μηδὲ διδάξῃς ἐπὶ σεαυτὸν παιδείαν πονηράν.

verses.geez: ኢትመጥዋ፡ ለብእሲት፡ ነፍሰከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትትከየድ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኀይልከ።
verses.translation: Give not thy soul unto a woman to set her foot upon thy substance.

translations.lxx: Give not thy soul unto a woman to set her foot upon thy substance.
translations.ron: Nu te da în mâinile unei femei, ca să nu aibă putere asupra ta.
translations.grk: Μὴ δῷς γυναικὶ τὴν ψυχήν σου, ἐπιβῆναι αὐτὴν ἐπὶ τὴν ἰσχύν σου.

verses.geez: ኢትሰሐጥ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ባዕድ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትደቅ፡ ውስተ፡ መሥገርታ።
verses.translation: Meet not with an harlot, lest thou fall into her snares.

translations.lxx: Meet not with an harlot, lest thou fall into her snares.
translations.ron: Nu te întâlni cu femeia desfrânată, ca să nu cazi în laţurile ei.
translations.grk: Μὴ ὑπάντα γυναικὶ ἑταιριζομένῃ, μήποτε ἐμπέσῃς εἰς τὰς παγίδας αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወኢትዛዋዕ፡ ምስለ፡ መሰንቃዊት፡ ከመ፡ ኢታሥግርከ፡ በማሕሌታ።
verses.translation: Use not much the company of a woman that is a singer, lest thou be taken with her attempts.

translations.lxx: Use not much the company of a woman that is a singer, lest thou be taken with her attempts.
translations.ron: Cu femeia cântăreaţă să nu fii adesea, ca nu cumva să te prindă cu meşteşugurile ei.
translations.grk: Μετὰ ψαλλούσης μὴ ἐνδελέχιζε, μήποτε ἁλῷς ἐν τοῖς ἐπιχειρήμασιν αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: Gaze not on a maid, that thou fall not by those things that are precious in her.

translations.lxx: Gaze not on a maid, that thou fall not by those things that are precious in her.
translations.ron: Nu-ţi opri privirea asupra unei fecioare, ca să nu ai a suferi pentru ea.
translations.grk: Παρθένον μὴ καταμάνθανε, μήποτε σκανδαλισθῇς ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτιμίοις αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ኢትመጥዋ፡ ለዘማ፡ ነፍሰከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትህጐል፡ ርስተከ።
verses.translation: Give not thy soul unto harlots, that thou lose not thine inheritance.

translations.lxx: Give not thy soul unto harlots, that thou lose not thine inheritance.
translations.ron: Nu te da în mâinile desfrânatelor, ca să nu-ţi pierzi moştenirea.
translations.grk: Μὴ δῷς πόρναις τὴν ψυχήν σου, ἵνα μὴ ἀπολέσῃς τὴν κληρονομίαν σου.

verses.geez: ወኢትኅሥሥ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናዊሃ፡ ለሀገር፡ ከመ፡ ኢያስሕትከ፡ ጽጐጕሃ።
verses.translation: Look not round about thee in the streets of the city, neither wander thou in the solitary places thereof.

translations.lxx: Look not round about thee in the streets of the city, neither wander thou in the solitary places thereof.
translations.ron: Nu privi pe uliţele cetăţii, nici nu rătăci prin locurile ei dosnice.
translations.grk: Μὴ περιβλέπου ἐν ῥύμαις πόλεως, καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἐρήμοις αὐτῆς μὴ πλανῶ.

verses.geez: ሚጥ፡ ዐይነከ፡ እምነ፡ ብእሲት፡ ሠናይት፡ ወኢያፍቱከ፡ ሥና፡ ለብእሲት፡ ባዕድ፡ ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ስሕቱ፡ በሥነ፡ ብእሲት፡ ወእንበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይነድድ፡ ፍቅር፡ ከመ፡ እሳት።
verses.translation: Turn away thine eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another's beauty; for many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman; for herewith love is kindled as a fire.

translations.lxx: Turn away thine eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another's beauty; for many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman; for herewith love is kindled as a fire.
translations.ron: Întoarce-ţi ochii de la femeia frumoasă şi nu-ţi opri privirea la frumuseţea străină. Cu frumuseţea femeii mulţi s-au rătăcit, căci din aceasta iubirea se aprinde ca un foc.
translations.grk: Ἀπόστρεψον ὀφθαλμὸν ἀπὸ γυναικὸς εὐμόρφου, καὶ μὴ καταμάνθανε κάλλος ἀλλότριον· ἐν κάλλει γυναικὸς πολλοὶ ἐπλανήθησαν, καὶ ἐκ τούτου φιλία ὡς πῦρ ἀνακαίεται.

verses.geez: ኢትንበር፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወኢትሠገር፡ ምስሌሃ፡ በስታይ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትግምድ፡ ነፍስከ፡ መንገሌሃ፡ ወኢታድኅፅ፡ መንፈስከ፡ ውስተ፡ ሞት።
verses.translation: Sit not at all with another man's wife, nor sit down with her in thine arms, and spend not thy money with her at the wine; lest thine heart incline unto her, and so through thy desire thou fall into destruction.

translations.lxx: Sit not at all with another man's wife, nor sit down with her in thine arms, and spend not thy money with her at the wine; lest thine heart incline unto her, and so through thy desire thou fall into destruction.
translations.ron: Nu te aşeza nicidecum lângă o femeie măritată şi nu petrece cu ea la masă bând, ca nu cumva inima ta să fie cucerită de vrăjile ei şi în patima ta să nu fii târât la pieire.
translations.grk: Μετὰ ὑπάνδρου γυναικὸς μὴ κάθου τὸ σύνολον, καὶ μὴ συμβολοκοπήσῃς μετʼ αὐτῆς ἐν οἴνῳ, μήποτε ἐκκλίνῃ ἡ ψυχή σου ἐπʼ αὐτὴν, καὶ τῷ πνεύματί σου ὀλισθήσῃς εἰς ἀπώλειαν.

verses.geez: ወኢትኅድግ፡ ዐርክከ፡ ዘትካት፡ እስመ፡ ኢይከውነከ፡ ከማሁ፡ ዐርከ፡ ግብት፡ ዐርከ፡ ሐዲስ፡ ወይን፡ ሐዲስ፡ ወእመሰ፡ ከረመ፡ ትሰትዮ፡ በትፍሥሕት።
verses.translation: Forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him: a new friend is as new wine; when it is old, thou shalt drink it with pleasure.

translations.lxx: Forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him: a new friend is as new wine; when it is old, thou shalt drink it with pleasure.
translations.ron: Nu părăsi un prieten vechi, căci cel nou nu este asemenea lui. Prieten nou, vin nou; lasă-l să se învechească şi-l bea cu plăcere.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς φίλον ἀρχαῖον, ὁ γὰρ πρόσφατος οὐκ ἔστιν ἔφισος αὐτῷ· οἶνος νέος, φίλος νέος, ἐὰν παλαιωθῇ, μετʼ εὐφροσύνης πίεσαι αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ኢያቅንእከ፡ ብዕሎሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ እስመ፡ ኢተአምር፡ ዘከመ፡ ይትገፈትኡ።
verses.translation: Envy not the glory of a sinner: for thou knowest not what shall be his end.

translations.lxx: Envy not the glory of a sinner: for thou knowest not what shall be his end.
translations.ron: Nu râvni izbânda păcătosului, căci nu ştii care cum se va sfârşi.
translations.grk: Μὴ ζηλώσῃς δόξαν ἁμαρτωλοῦ, οὐ γὰρ οἶδας τί ἔσται ἡ καταστροφὴ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወኢያፍቱከ፡ ተድላሆሙ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ተዘከር፡ ከመ፡ ኢይጸድቁ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ይመውቱ።
verses.translation: Delight not in the thing that the ungodly have pleasure in; but remember they shall not go unpunished unto their grave.

translations.lxx: Delight not in the thing that the ungodly have pleasure in; but remember they shall not go unpunished unto their grave.
translations.ron: Nu-ţi face plăcere din plăcerea nelegiuitului; adu-ţi aminte că nu vor rămâne nepedepsiţi până la iad.
translations.grk: Μὴ εὐδοκήσῃς ἐν εὐδοκίᾳ ἀσεβῶν, μνήσθητι ὅτι ἕως ᾅδου οὐ μὴ δικαιωθῶσι.

verses.geez: ረሐቅ፡ ነዋኀ፡ መካነ፡ እምነ፡ መኳንንት፡ ዘነፍሰ፡ ይኴንኑ፡ ወኢይርከብከ፡ ትሕዝብተ፡ ሞት፡ እመኒ፡ ቀረብካሆሙ፡ ኢትነስሕ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትግድፍ፡ ሕይወትከ፡ ወአእምር፡ ዳእሙ፡ ከመ፡ ማእከለ፡ መሥገርት፡ ተኀልፍ፡ ወከመ፡ ዘማእከለ፡ ቀልቀል፡ ታንሶሱ።
verses.translation: Keep thee far from the man that hath power to kill: so shalt thou not doubt the fear of death: and if thou come unto him, make no fault, lest he take away thy life presently: remember that thou goest in the midst of snares, and that thou walkest upon the battlements of the city.

translations.lxx: Keep thee far from the man that hath power to kill: so shalt thou not doubt the fear of death: and if thou come unto him, make no fault, lest he take away thy life presently: remember that thou goest in the midst of snares, and that thou walkest upon the battlements of the city.
translations.ron: Stai departe de omul care este în stare să ucidă şi nu te vei teme nicidecum de moarte. Şi dacă te apropii de el, păzeşte-te de orice greşeală, căci ar putea să-ţi ia viaţa. Să ştii bine că eşti înconjurat de curse şi că mergi pe margine de ziduri de cetate.
translations.grk: Μακρὰν ἄπεχε ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ὃς ἔχει ἐξουσιαν τοῦ φονεύειν, καὶ οὐ μὴ ὑποπτεύσῃς φόβον θανάτου· κᾂν προσέλθῃς, μὴ πλημμελήσῃς, ἵνα μὴ ἀφέληται τὴν ζωήν σου· ἐπίγνωθι ὅτι ἐν μέσῳ παγίδων διαβαίνεις, καὶ ἐπὶ ἐπάλξεων πόλεων περιπατεῖς.

verses.geez: በአምጣነ፡ ትክል፡ አሠኒ፡ ለቢጽከ፡ ወምስለ፡ ጠቢባን፡ ተማከር።
verses.translation: As near as thou canst, guess at thy neighbour, and consult with the wise.

translations.lxx: As near as thou canst, guess at thy neighbour, and consult with the wise.
translations.ron: Cercetează cât poţi pe aproapele tău şi ia sfat de la înţelepţi.
translations.grk: Κατὰ τὴν ἰσχύν σου στόχασαι τοὺς πλησίον, καὶ μετὰ σοφῶν συμβουλεύου.

verses.geez: ወምስለ፡ ማእምራን፡ ይኩን፡ ትካዝከ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ነገርከ፡ በሕገ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይኩንከ።
verses.translation: Let thy talk be with the wise, and all thy communication in the law of the most High.

translations.lxx: Let thy talk be with the wise, and all thy communication in the law of the most High.
translations.ron: Stai de vorbă cu oamenii înţelepţi şi tot cuvântul tău să fie despre legea Celui Preaînalt.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετὰ συνετῶν ἔστω ὁ διαλογισμός σου, καὶ πᾶσα διήγησίς σου ἐν νόμῳ ὑψίστου.

verses.geez: ወዕደው፡ ጻድቃን፡ የሀልዉ፡ ውስተ፡ ምሳሕከ፡ ወበፍርሀተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይኩን፡ ምሳሕከ።
verses.translation: And let just men eat and drink with thee; and let thy glorying be in the fear of the Lord.

translations.lxx: And let just men eat and drink with thee; and let thy glorying be in the fear of the Lord.
translations.ron: Cei drepţi să fie oaspeţii tăi şi în frica Domnului să fie lauda ta.
translations.grk: Ἄνδρες δίκαιοι ἔστωσαν σύνδειπνοί σου, καὶ ἐν φόβῳ Κυρίου ἔστω τὸ καύχημά σου.

verses.geez: ወበውስተ፡ እደ፡ ኬንያሁ፡ ይትለማዕ፡ ግብሩ፡ ወለመልአከ፡ አሕዛብኒ፡ ይንእድዎ፡ በጥበበ፡ ቃሉ።
verses.translation: For the hand of the artificer the work shall be commended; and the wise ruler of the people for his speech.

translations.lxx: For the hand of the artificer the work shall be commended; and the wise ruler of the people for his speech.
translations.ron: Un lucru făcut de mână de meşter este vrednic de laudă, dar conducătorul poporului să fie iscusit la cuvânt.
translations.grk: Ἐν χειρὶ τεχνιτῶν ἔργον ἐπαινεθήσεται, καὶ ὁ ἡγούμενος λαοῦ σοφὸς ἐν λόγῳ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ግሩም፡ ውእቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ነባቢ፡ በውስተ፡ ሀገሩ፡ ወይጸልእዎ፡ ለዝሉፉ፡ እምነ፡ ቃሉ።
verses.translation: A man of an ill tongue is dangerous in his city; and he that is rash in his talk shall be hated.

translations.lxx: A man of an ill tongue is dangerous in his city; and he that is rash in his talk shall be hated.
translations.ron: Cel care vorbeşte bine este temut în cetate, şi flecarul este urât.
translations.grk: Φοβερὸς ἐν πόλει αὐτοῦ ἀνὴρ γλωσσώδης, καὶ ὁ προπετὴς ἐν λόγῳ αὐτοῦ μισηθήσεται.
